definitions.explanation: A product released in a limited quantity or for a limited time. Common for books, games, merchandise, and collectibles.

examples.japanese: {限定版|げんていばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{売|う}り{切|き}れた→売り切れる：03012_urikireru⟧。
examples.english: The limited edition sold out immediately.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦ゲーム→ゲーム：03842_geemu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{限定版|げんていばん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{特典|とくてん}→特典：13469_tokuten⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{付|つ}いている→付く：01960_tsuku⟧。
examples.english: The limited edition of this game comes with bonus items.

examples.japanese: {限定版|げんていばん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{通常版|つうじょうばん}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦コレクター→コレクター：20000_korekutaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Limited editions are more expensive than regular editions, but they are popular with collectors.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of ⟦{限定|げんてい}→限定：10997_gentei⟧ (limited) and {版|ばん} (edition). Used across many product categories — games, books, DVDs, figures, and more.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{数量|すうりょう}→数量：05473_suuryou⟧{限定版|げんていばん} (quantity-limited edition)
- ⟦{初回|しょかい}→初回：11780_shokai⟧{限定版|げんていばん} (first-run limited edition)
- {限定版|げんていばん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{予約|よやく}する→予約する：22989_yoyakusuru⟧ (to preorder the limited edition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {通常版|つうじょうばん}: regular edition — the standard version, as opposed to {限定版|げんていばん}
- ⟦{改訂版|かいていばん}→改訂版：17716_kaiteiban⟧: revised edition — an updated version of a publication
